summary.text: Nick Rowe is the Democratic candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the incumbent is Matt Hall (R).
An Air Force veteran and university faculty member, he defeated Bill Korb in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Rowe served in the U.S. Air Force from 2002 to 2022.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 2002 and a graduate degree from Webster University, and his career experience includes working in higher education.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he serves as a full-time faculty member at Western Michigan University and lives in the Gull Lake area.

In the survey, Rowe said his priorities include lowering the cost of groceries, housing, healthcare and childcare, investing in education and innovation, and protecting constitutional freedoms and civil liberties.
He listed VoteVets.org as an endorser.
